title: Field and Method
goal: Give User a typed field, then read it in the method without stealing it.
hints: Struct fields are name: Type, like parameters.
Inside a method, fields are reached through self.
explanation: Fields are declared `name: Type` (E0063-adjacent syntax errors otherwise). Inside the method, the field is `self.name`; a bare `name` is an unknown variable (E0425). Returning `self.name` directly would move the String out of a borrowed `&self`, which is E0507 - your first sight of the borrow checker guarding a struct. `to_uppercase()` sidesteps it by producing a fresh String.
